title: OpenDeception: Benchmarking and Investigating AI Deceptive Behaviors via Open-ended Simulation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on deceptive behaviors in scenarios like telecommunications fraud, deceptive product promotion, personal safety risks, emotional deception, and privacy stealing.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research.
